scientific_integrity: Exhaustive finite theorem supported by two standalone C++17 enumeration programs and a nonempty-subset closure argument. No infinite-state assertion is made.
scientific_limitations: Only complete labeled three-state unary and ordered-binary tree automata; recent full-text access and unindexed equivalent work are residual originality risks. No external review.
title: A sharp height–leaf Pareto tradeoff in three-state unary–binary tree synchronization
